title: Threat enemy contact does not trigger player death
explanation: State snapshot at frame 2040 shows Enemy5 (is_threat=true) at x=6826.5,y=800.0 with player at x=6746.54,y=799.98, distance 80.0 (contact) and stats.deaths=0. No player_died, player_hurt or player_damaged events appear after this contact; stats.deaths remains 0 through the rest of the window. The later player_removed event at frame 914 occurs without any death increment, confirming the missing damage.
